title: Waiver of Collection-Service Fees — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
## Policy

An assessed collection-service fee on a Specimen Collection Appointments visit is waived in full, never in part, and for exactly one reason. A fee may be waived at most once: a fee that already carries a waiver line on the visit's fee record is not waived again. When the waived fee was already paid, the payment is refunded under the refund rule.

| Waiver reason | Applies to |
|---|---|
| Laboratory-initiated cancellation | Any fee on a visit the laboratory cancelled |
| Severe weather closure | A fee arising on a day the laboratory declared a weather closure for the site's area, where the visit type provides a weather-closure fee waiver |
| Recollection visit | A fee assessed in error on a recollection visit |
| First-occurrence courtesy | Only a late-cancellation fee or a no-show fee, only when the patient asks, and only while the patient's count of courtesy waivers in the last 365 days is below the visit type's courtesy allowance |

Trip, additional-patient and weekend fees on a collected visit are never waived as a courtesy.

## The courtesy count

The count of courtesy waivers covers the patient's fee lines waived as a first-occurrence courtesy whose waiver date falls within the 365 calendar days before today, today included.

## The request window

A courtesy or weather waiver must be requested no later than the visit type's waiver request window (in calendar days) after the fee was assessed. The request window counts calendar days with the assessment date as day 0, and a request on the last day is on time. The assessment date is the date on the fee line being waived, as the visit's fee record shows it.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

| Fee assessed on | Request made on | Day number | Within the window? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day A | Day A | 0 | Yes |
| Day A | Day A plus 30 | 30 | Yes — the last day is on time |
| Day A | Day A plus 31 | 31 | No |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit patient (courtesy allowance 1) asks to waive a no-show fee within the window and has no courtesy waiver in the last 365 days: the count is 0, below 1, so the courtesy reason is open.
- The same patient with one courtesy waiver dated 200 days ago: the count is 1, not below 1, so the courtesy reason is not open.
- A trip fee on a collected home visit: never waived as a courtesy.
- A fee on a visit the laboratory cancelled: the laboratory-initiated cancellation reason applies; the request window governs only courtesy and weather waivers.
